name: provenrail
description: A spend cap and a delete policy for coding agents, enforced in the tool hook and signed into a receipt anyone can verify.

plugins.name: provenrail-guard
plugins.description: A day spend cap that refuses the next tool call once your agent has spent it, plus delete and git rules that screen where a command points rather than what it says. Deterministic, offline, and it runs in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK and CI, where the auto mode classifier does not run at all.
